evidence.quote: The Bachelor's Degree Programme in Economics: Behavior, Data and Policy is a three-year programme, entirely taught in English
The Bachelor's Degree Programme in Economics: Behavior, Data and Policy is a three-year programme, entirely taught in English, that aims to provide a basic but solid knowledge of economic theory

notes: Tuition: no annual tuition amount for a non-EU student living abroad is stated for this programme; the programme page gives only a general description of two instalments, and the international fees page says the second instalment varies by country group without giving an amount, so tuition is omitted. Intakes: the programme page gives an admission application window 12/03/2026–06/07/2026, but this is a general deadline that the page does not say is for non-EU or foreign-qualification applicants, and the only non-EU-specific deadline (30 April 2026) is for master's degree applicants, not for this Bachelor, so intakes are omitted. Documents: the programme page names no document list for applicants; the university's international enrolment page lists documents for Bachelor applicants (high school diploma etc.), but those lists are institution-wide and are in the 'Lauree triennali e magistrali a ciclo unico' section rather than being stated for this programme, so documents are omitted here.

evidence.quote: prospective students must hold an upper secondary school diploma or equivalent qualification obtained abroad after at least 12 years of schooling

note.fr: Le nombre de places est limité : 100 + 15 réservées aux candidats non-UE résidant à l'étranger. Un test d'admission CEnT-S en anglais (sections Mathématiques et Raisonnement) est requis.
note.en: Places are limited: 100 + 15 reserved for non-EU candidates residing abroad. An admission test CEnT-S in English (Mathematics and Reasoning sections) is required.

evidence.quote: the maximum number of students who can enroll in the Bachelor's Degree programme in Economics: Behavior, Data and Policy is set at 100, plus 15 places reserved for international non-EU candidates residing abroad
